skillsbench-workspace-setup.name: skillsbench-workspace-setup
key_points: Host verifier never reads container filesystem — files written inside Docker during execution must be mirrored to `tasks/<id>/` or they won't appear in host staging.
skillsbench-workspace-setup.description: SkillsBench workspace implementation workflow: reading tests first, handling pre-existing starter files, building inside Docker, and staging deliverables correctly.

skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS write deliverables to the task directory (`tasks/<id>/`), NOT to `/root/` on the host filesystem. The host verifier only stages files from the task directory to `<stage>/root/`.
skillsbench-host-grading.description: How SkillsBench host verification works — where deliverables must live, what the verifier checks, and common pitfalls.
